summary: The inventory service experienced container crash loops after a configuration change updated DB_URL to point to a non-existent database host (postgres-primary) instead of postgres.

alerts.name: PodCrashLooping
alerts.summary: inventory: container restarted 3.063 times in 10 minutes

hypotheses.summary: A configuration change set DB_URL to postgres-primary:5432, which does not exist, causing database connection failures and container crash loops during startup.

evidence.quote: inventory: move to the new primary database endpoint (#164)

evidence.shows: Change to non-existent database hostname postgres-primary

evidence.quote: Unable to obtain connection from database: The connection attempt failed.
evidence.shows: Application startup failure due to database connection error

hypotheses.suggested_fix: Revert the DB_URL configuration change in services/inventory.yaml back to postgres:5432/inventory.

approvals.title: Revert "inventory: move to the new primary database endpoint (#164)"
